name: TED University

programs.title: You should fill out the online application form.
You should submit an updated CV to the online application system.
You must have a bachelor's degree from a recognized college. Depending on the graduate program, the specific undergraduate degree required may differ.
You should submit your academic transcripts and records.
You must provide recommendation letters from professors or professionals who can evaluate your academic and research potential.
You must submit a statement of purpose.
You must have a valid Exam Result (ALES or GRE/GMAT).
For Architecture and Urban Studies, you must submit a portfolio.
You must demonstrate your English language proficiency through standardized tests like EPE, Toefl-IBT, and Toefl-PBT+TWE.
You must submit your transcript and equivalency letter to ensure that your academic qualifications align with Turkish standards.

description: TED is a private institution in Turkey. It was founded in 2012 and is part of the TED (Turkish Education Association) Group, a well-known educational institution in Turkey with roots dating back to 1928. The university's campus is in Ankara, Turkey's capital city. It has sophisticated facilities that facilitate students' academic and extracurricular interests, such as classrooms, laboratories, libraries, and recreational places. The goal of TED University was to provide a high-quality education that blends academic achievement with an emphasis on research and innovation. Thus, faculty and students are encouraged to participate in cross-disciplinary research projects. The university also encourages entrepreneurship and industrial collaboration. According to the "Turkish University Satisfaction Survey" 2023, TEDU is among the top five universities in student satisfaction. TED University aspires to develop international connections and partnerships. This includes student exchange programs, collaborative research projects, and partnerships with institutions worldwide.
